title: Prompt Injection: Spot the Hidden Order in Your Repo Files
description:
Your README can give orders to your AI agent, and you'd never see them. 🕵️

✅ Why agents obey text hidden in repo files
✅ Scan with grep for ignore previous and comment tags
✅ Treat file text as data, never as orders

Day 6 of Safe AI Agents! Next up, Day 7: Vet an MCP Server Before You Install.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to lock down your AI coding agents.

#shorts #promptinjection #aisecurity #aiagents #aicoding #claudecode #grep
comment: Grep or eyeball: which would you try first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: grep -o prints only the matching part, so the hit is easy to spot even in a huge file.
